clues: This town sits in the South West Slopes of New South Wales, in Australia. The Olympic Highway crosses Muttama Creek right in town.
Summers here are hot and dry, but fierce storms break in. Winters are cool and grey, with rain on many days, and snow can fall.
A home in this town held Aboriginal girls by force. The girls had been taken from their families.
The best bat in cricket was born in this town. Sir Donald Bradman is still called the greatest batsman of all time.
Each year, this town holds a Wattle Time Festival. It marks the bloom of the wattle, a plant that bears this town's name.
